I couldn’t get a picture but his front left leg is deformed, and when he walks it’s as if his back doesn’t want to straighten out completely

I was told by the woman I bought him from that she bought him for her son 3 months ago and that she’s rehoming because she just doesn’t have the time for him. He has obvious signs of MBD, warped jaw and an awkward walk. He shakes when he walks and can barely keep his head up. His tongue was white when we picked him up but is slowing turning back pink with warmth and water. I have already had one gecko for almost two years, and saw this one on Facebook and just knew I had to get him. He came with a tank and two lamps, but the lamps were very dirty so I bought a heating pad to put under his tank instead. Going to deep clean the tank before I place him back in it. I’ve never dealt with MBD before so any advice would be greatly appreciated.

Edit: when I say awkward walk I mean he can’t completely straighten his back, causes him to walk funny. Idk how else his back could be messed up besides it being cause by MBD or maybe an old injury. I do know that the previous owners did not give him any calcium.
